about: Public-notice channels per operator or agency: pages, sites, feeds, lists and accounts through which the public is told of sewage discharges, by law, permit or voluntarily. Read by pipeline/ingest/notification_pages.py (schema and validator there; test tests/test_notice_channels.py).

channels.name: Allegheny County Health Department
channels.note: Allegheny County Health Department river and CSO advisories. Voluntary in the research; alerts 'usually canceled 24 to 36 hours after sewer overflows end'. (research/pa/report.md §2)

channels.name: ALCOSAN SEW SYS
channels.legal_basis: ALCOSAN NPDES permit PA0025984 / 2008 consent decree (CSO public notification)
channels.note: ALCOSAN SOAK text and email alerts (Everbridge). Sign-up status: not attempted (docs/subscriptions.md). (research/pa/report.md §2)

channels.name: ALCOSAN SEW SYS
channels.legal_basis: ALCOSAN NPDES permit PA0025984 / 2008 consent decree (CSO public notification)
channels.note: ALCOSAN orange CSO flags at nine river sites; signs at 259 CSO and 53 SSO structures. The SOAK log is the online record of the flag state. (research/pa/report.md §2)

channels.name: ALCOSAN SEW SYS
channels.note: ALCOSAN news posts (off-season events such as the 2026-03-06 power outage). Voluntary; events outside the SOAK season. (research/pa/report.md §2)

channels.name: ALCOSAN SEW SYS
channels.legal_basis: 25 Pa. Code § 92a.47(b): Nine Minimum Controls in each CSO permit, control 8 public notification (no deadline set); DEP CSO FAQ #34: permittees should have a public notification plan, copy on request; ALCOSAN 2008 consent decree
channels.note: ALCOSAN SEW SYS: CSO public notification (NMC 8). SOAK log: 'Overflows are in effect; Minimize contact with waterways'; Apr 1-Oct 31, 8 a.m.-7 p.m.; advisories stand 48 hours after overflows end. (research/pa/report.md §1-3)

channels.name: Bartram's Garden water quality monitoring
channels.note: Bartram's Garden water quality monitoring. Voluntary. Schuylkill. (research/pa/report.md §2)

channels.name: Delaware Riverkeeper Network
channels.note: Delaware Riverkeeper Network. Voluntary. Prior art. (research/pa/report.md §2)

channels.name: DELCORA STP
channels.legal_basis: DELCORA 2015 consent decree (visual notification)
channels.note: DELCORA warning lights and flags at public-access sites (Delaware River, Chester and Ridley creeks). No online status found (delcora.org CSO pages fetched). (research/pa/report.md §2)

channels.name: Pennsylvania sewer system operators
channels.legal_basis: 25 Pa. Code § 91.33(a): notify DEP and, if reasonably possible, known downstream users
channels.note: No web form: Notice to known downstream users after a discharge. Direct notice; no web form. DEP itself publishes no overflow notices. Covers every operator in the state. (research/pa/report.md §1)
channels.barrier_review: the register does not say what keeps it off the web: no web form: notice to known downstream users after a discharge. direct notice; no web form. dep itself publishes no ove

channels.agency: Delaware River Basin Commission bacteria monitoring
channels.name: Delaware River Basin Commission bacteria monitoring
channels.note: Delaware River Basin Commission bacteria monitoring. Voluntary. Monitoring only. (research/pa/report.md §2)

channels.name: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (ECHO)
channels.note: No rows for this state in EPA's dataset: EPA ECHO sewer overflow and bypass event records (NPDES eReporting). Voluntary publication by EPA: operators must report noncompliance to the permitting authority within 24 hours (40 CFR 122.41(l)(6)); EPA publishes the electronic reports. No PA rows in the dataset (research/pa); add the state to the ingester's STATES when rows appear. Covers every operator in the state. (research/federal/report.md)
channels.barrier_review: the register does not say what keeps it off the web: no rows for this state in epa's dataset: epa echo sewer overflow and bypass event records (npdes ereporting). voluntary
